Team — forwarding a 14-day dedicated carve request from Nimbus (details attached). Key asks I need to resolve before I commit:
1) Feasibility & lead time (Marcus) — can we provision 8x A100 equiv for Aug 4 start?
2) Operational mode (Marcus/Dev) — reserve slice vs burst lane with autoscale exception. Which is lower risk?
3) Pricing & billing path (Kimberly/Laura) — what premium applies for short carve + PO requirements?
4) Compliance & onboarding (Laura) — any extra paperwork for a short-term carve?

Can we treat this as 14-day bridge (Aug 4–18). Nimbus is willing to sign a short-term addendum. If we can approve, I want to move fast — please reply with short, actionable answers and owners.

— Rachel

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>

Date: 2025-07-20T18:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Temporary dedicated capacity request for launch

SG — quick notes from infra:
- Feasibility: yes. We can carve an 8x A100-equivalent slice out of the Orin dedicated pool for 14 days, but scheduling depends on current reservations. If we prep images and warm caches now we can hit Aug 4 with ~72h lead time for slot placement + 12h warm-up.
- Operational trade-offs: reserved slice = predictable throughput and KV cache isolation; burst lane/autoscale exception cheaper in infra ops terms but riskier for strict latency SLOs because queueing could occur under extreme fanout. For latency-sensitive launch I recommend reserved slice.
- Work required: provisioning runbook (I can own), kernel/quant profiles for their model (we need sample artifacts), and network egress rules.
- Cost ops: I put together a quick sizing calc (attached) that assumes 8x A100 for 14 days. Note: if we go reserved, we also need to block that capacity from internal slots — affects other pilots.

I attached capacity_sizing_calc.csv. If Rachel approves reserved slice, I'll create the infra ticket and schedule the carve window.

— Marcus
Senior Infrastructure Engineer
Redwood Inference
attachments: capacity_sizing_calc.csv

Thanks — pricing & procurement notes:
- Short-term dedicated carve: pricing premium is standardly 1.5x of equivalent committed-rate pro rata for <30-day reservations. This covers scheduling churn and opportunity cost.
- Billing: we can accept a PO signed by Nimbus. For a repeatable pattern we can propose a short-term Addendum (2 pages) — legal can spin this.
- Approvals: finance needs the PO and expected cost estimate to approve the carve. Laura, will you need anything else for compliance?

If sales wants to approve at 1.5x, we can move forward quickly; otherwise take burst-lane option and a 1.2x uplift.

— Kim
Director, Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference
From: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.com>
To: rachel.kim@redwood.com, marcus.lin@redwood.com, kimberly.park@redwood.com
Date: 2025-07-21T11:47:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Temporary dedicated capacity request for launch

Adding technical ops detail for an autoscale exception if we go that route:
> On Jul 20, 2025, at 6:22 PM, Marcus Lin wrote:
> > If reserved slice, I can create infra ticket and schedule the carve.

- Autoscale exception approach: enable burst lane with guaranteed min-instances=4 and allow burst-to-8 for 14 days. Requires a one-time policy toggle in the routing layer and a priority tag so Nimbus requests route to the reserved pool during the window.
- Rollback plan: remove priority tag + drain new in-flight requests over 10 minutes, and revoke policy at close-of-business on Aug 18.
- Risk note: prefix/KV cache cold-start will increase tokens per response early in the window; we should prewarm by running a small set of synthetic traffic on Aug 2–3 (Marcus to run).

If we approve reserved slice I prefer that for simplicity. If we approve burst-lane, I need the PO signed before policy toggle.

— Dev
Platform Ops
Redwood Inference

2) Billing: approve 1.5x short-term premium; Laura/Kimberly to capture PO & send short addendum to Nimbus.
3) Ops: Marcus to run the provisioning ticket and a warm-up synthetic traffic run on Aug 2–3; Dev to coordinate the routing policy and rollback plan.
4) Compliance: Laura, flag any onboarding docs Nimbus must sign; hold final provisioning until PO is received.

Priya/Amit — we're green to proceed pending a signed PO. Kimberly/Laura will follow up with the invoice and addendum template by EOD. Marcus & Dev will sync on runbook and provisioning schedule. I'll own coordination and send a calendar invite for a short preflight on Jul 30.

Thanks — moving fast on this.
